  same finding has identical fingerprint whether found by bandit-only, bandit+semgrep,
  or ast-only; engine-specific type only used as last resort
- issue_classes.py: complete bandit test_id coverage (B601-B609, B102, B105-B107,

  honesty rule; fallback to File table only for legacy scans without scanned_files;
  path comparisons use normpath+separator-only normalization, no .lower()
- diff.py: score_after and severity_delta set to null when any not_comparable findings
  exist, preventing artificial score inflation when a detector fails or file is removed
- models/models.py: scanned_files column already present (Text, JSON-encoded filepath list)
- backend/api/scans.py: populate scanned_files on scan completion
- database/migration.py: ensure scanned_files column exists on existing deployments
- test_step8.py: all 14 tests pass including fingerprint cross-engine stability,
  score null honesty, per-scan file coverage immutability

- scripts: reorganize benchmark under benchmarks/, add scenario runner and screenshot scripts

feat(ai): add Groq (default) and Ollama (optional) provider support

- OpenAIProvider now accepts base_url + timeout for OpenAI-compatible endpoints
- get_ai_provider() factory dispatches to groq / ollama / openai / template
  based on AI_PROVIDER setting

- Auto model-fallback on Groq model_not_found errors
- config.py: add AI_PROVIDER, GROQ_API_KEY, GROQ_MODEL, OLLAMA_BASE_URL,
  OLLAMA_MODEL, OPENAI_MODEL settings + extra='ignore' for unknown env vars
- Add test_ai_providers.py: 9 unit tests covering all provider branches
- Add scripts/run_verification.py: end-to-end 5-step verification script

All 54 tests pass.
